## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Architecture / decision record
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` (when Rust code is present)
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` (when Rust code is present)
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked` (when Rust code is present)
- [ ] TypeScript checks and tests (when TypeScript packages are present)
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No secrets or local-only files included

## Architecture impact

Describe affected contracts, adapters, compatibility, and decision records.
